title: Trace checks during expression evaluation
description: You can see which child calculations finish before an enclosing operation is checked.

steps.description: Literal nodes return their values. Other nodes evaluate left and right children before incrementing and printing the check counter.
The arithmetic path accepts two floats or, for addition, two strings. Other pairs raise the displayed TypeError.
Less-than requires matching runtime types. good supplies numeric children, while bad supplies a mixed string-number addition on its right.

steps.question: Will bad reach its outer less-than check after the right addition fails?
steps.answer: No. The child TypeError interrupts evaluation before that outer check.

steps.description: The first recording reaches final value True after three checks. The second completes the left sum, then stops on its second check with a string-number error.
